name: Plague Drone
oracle_text:
Flying
Rot Fly — If an opponent would gain life, that player loses that much life instead.
blocked_sentences: Rot Fly — If an opponent would gain life, that player loses that much life instead.

needs.what: a player-wide replacement static (Tainted Remedy / Rain of Gore shape) that replaces a life gain by an affected player (affects_player: opponent) with a loss of that much life by the same player, read in primitives.gain_life so lifelink and the gain_life op both reach it, e.g. replace_life_gain with a `lose_instead: true` axis
needs.why_existing_wont_do: replace_life_gain only scales the gain (gain_multiplier >= 2 or gain_addend >= 1) and the loader refuses any other shape; cant_gain_life stops the gain but makes no one lose life; a you_gain_life trigger plus lose_life would let the gain happen and then use the stack, which is a different card
